depends_on: approved A design and parent implementation instruction

inputs.candidate: full commit or pre-commit staged tree SHA
inputs.source_scope: demiflow/**/*.py; exclude _vendor; exclude root facade demiflow from SCC; preserve other package initializers
inputs.unstaged_source_binding: remains release coordinator responsibility; report describes immutable Git sources only

outputs: outer receipt with status, paths and SHA-256
phases.determinism: Main report bytes do not include clock, output absolute paths or elapsed time.

diagnostic_semantics.declaration_scope: Existing architecture v3 seeds plus import-time closure; report exact seed list and absences. Upward candidates are analytical, not a new approved layer policy.

limits.concurrency: One analysis process and at most one serial Git reader; one source AST resident at a time.

phases.standalone_error_exit: nonzero on incomplete/failed generation, never on numeric growth

gate_adapter.error_behavior: Record failure and bounded error independently; preserve actual gate.ok and its exit code.
gate_adapter.report_write_failure: Missing output receipt remains missing evidence, not successful delivery.

shared_fields.format: versioned diagnostic identifier, not product/runtime protocol
shared_fields.method: scanner version, scanner source SHA256, exact included/excluded modules, edge-kind policy and limitations
shared_fields.inputs: base/candidate requested SHA, input kind, commit SHA or null, tree SHA
shared_fields.snapshots: sorted inventories of module paths/content OIDs and per-snapshot analysis
shared_fields.delta: normalized dependency/member differences with before/after locations

scc-membership.json.snapshots: all nontrivial components sorted by members; base/workbench anchor presence and members; source paths
scc-membership.json.delta: new/deleted modules, cyclic entrants/exits split by new/existing/deleted, overlap links for changed components, changed edge rows

declaration-upward-imports.json.snapshots: actual/absent seeds, import-time closure, seed cross-package top/guarded candidates, closure lazy external edges grouped into anchor SCC and outside; typing/dynamic/symbol observations separate
declaration-upward-imports.json.delta: new/removed normalized candidate rows and before/after source locations

outer_receipt.status: complete or failed; not_requested belongs to merge_gate adapter
outer_receipt.runtime_fields: timestamps/elapsed/limits/interpreter and bounded error, not deterministic report contents
outer_receipt.files: absolute artifact path, bytes and SHA256 for each report actually generated

identity_impact.engine_platform_identity: Expected unchanged because no package .py input changes; prove package path/byte equality. Git SHA advances.
identity_impact.object_identity: No runtime object moves or source changes.
identity_impact.sealed_history: No change to serialized paths, bytes, formats or resume policy; old history and source preserved.
identity_impact.forge_platform_snapshot: Package source/declaration/dependency inputs expected unchanged; does not follow solely from engine hash.
identity_impact.forge_project_snapshot: Configured watch/sources may cover tests/tools/docs and therefore change; do not reuse old development evidence or alter watches.

implementation_status: No product or test implementation modified.
